text_block_list.text:
One day, while at the training track...
a delicious scent drifted through the air.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Simmer, simmer, slowly stewed curry♪
I hope everyone likes it~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...? 
Something smells good...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Oguri-chan.
Are you finished with training?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Hey Creek,
there's a really good smell coming from somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's from me~.
I made some curry and brought it over, you see♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Curry...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... wait.
Why curry...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan had training
since early this morning, you see.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I figured she'd come back starving,
so I was cooking it in the kitchen~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I ended up making too much.
So I brought some over to share with everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
In that case, don't mind if I do...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My my, were you that hungry? ♪
I'll get it ready right away, so please eat first.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you certainly ate a lot~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was delicious!
However, umm...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's quite alright, dear.
There are plenty of seconds, so eat to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome~. Children who eat lots
grow up big and strong, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the meal... Phew.
I wonder if I can still eat more.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Such incredible speed!
And to think you're still not full...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting all fired up now~♪ In that case,
I'll make sure you're completely stuffed!

Oguri Cap eats,
Super Creek serves,
Oguri Cap eats... and then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal... I'm stuffed...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ It was touch-and-go there for a bit,
but I'm glad we had enough curry♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could it be that I ended up
eating Tama's portion as well...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, are you worried about that?
What a good girl you are, Oguri-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though! I can whip up curry
in no time at all~. Leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Then I'll help you too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, really?
You truly are such a sweet girl, there there♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Muu...
